data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 35.195m. During 2015 the Syndicate reports a release of prior year technical reserves of GBP 8.7m, arising predominantly from fire and other damage to property, reflecting favourable claims development on prior years. A number of specific prior-year items from 2013 (including a medical isotope plant claim settled at GBP 1.7m, a UK fuel fabrication plant loss of GBP 1.5m and a GBP 1.4m China claim which was withdrawn) are discussed. Overall the prior year movement is a release and is concentrated in property-related business.
raw_causal_phrases: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 8.7m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2014: GBP 9.5m) arising predominantly from fire and other damage to property.
The claim was settled at GBP 1.7m.

An additional loss was experienced at a fuel fabrication plant in the UK, which cost the Syndicate GBP 1.5m. The reserve established of GBP 1.4m as a result of a possible material damage loss in China, was not required and the claim was withdrawn.
The total reserve for these two claims is GBP 2.4m.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Technical reserves table (page 25). Prior year development taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' narrative (page 19) which states a release of GBP 8.7m; this figure is treated as gross and used here. Claims development triangle available but presented on a net basis; triangle extraction was performed at moderate confidence. Some development/tracking rows in the triangle are partially ambiguous on the scanned page; triangle values therefore have lower confidence.
